featureGoals.title: Rust backend
featureGoals.goal: Move production serving, data processing, ranking calculation and refresh coordination to Rust while preserving ranking results and recovery contracts.

featureGoals.title: Code organization and development checks
featureGoals.goal: Make the repository understandable and make required checks catch real faults without losing runtime, source-ownership or recovery guarantees.

featureGoals.title: Tournaments and predictions
featureGoals.goal: Show current competitions, schedules, results, brackets, rule-correct Swiss draws and supported outcome forecasts with visible source and model evidence.

featureGoals.title: Ranking accuracy
featureGoals.goal: Keep team, player and league scores accurate and fair by validating source matches, identities, competition strength and model evidence.

featureGoals.title: Ranking updates and reliability
featureGoals.goal: Turn new results into complete, current and recoverable ranking generations with validated references, safe publication and bounded resource use.

featureGoals.title: Rankings interface and history
featureGoals.goal: Help people understand and compare ranking evidence through tables, filters, charts, team history and consistent score context.

featureGoals.title: Site appearance and branding
featureGoals.goal: Provide clear branding, reliable loading, readable layout, accessible controls and predictable navigation.

featureGoals.title: Product direction and requirements
featureGoals.goal: Build one connected League platform covering esports intelligence/scouting, builds and gameplay optimization, personal analytics, and a Windows/macOS companion.
